text: Harrand Fort Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Harrand Fort Type: Monument - Fort Province: Punjab District: Rajanpur Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1206 - 1526 CE Description: An almost circular fort built of small bricks and mud mortar. It has 16 bastions at a distance of 56m from each other. Each bastion measures 10mx6m across and is octagonal in shape. It has two main entrances on the western and eastern sides. The main entrance measures 4.35m with height of 4m. The size of bricks is 23x15x2.5 cm and 20x13x2.5cm.
